name: Localizing the Goal Representation of a VLA
summary: Tests whether a VLA obeys prohibitions stated in the instruction, locates the goal it executes with patching, probes and steering, and compares a goal read-out with failure detectors for catching non-compliance.
numbers: OpenVLA on LIBERO-Goal: forbidden task executed in 79% of negated rollouts vs 78% completion on plain instructions; goal read-out beats failure detectors

why.cog: Must respect a prohibition stated in language.
why.xr: Bounded harm; relevant to instruction-based safety constraints.
